On the island, there is a box of "Hefty" brand storage bags, some scattered items, and a large decorative vase with tall, white artificial flowers. There are three high chairs with dark seats around the island, and a handbag is hanging from one of the chairs. The floor is wooden, and the lighting is provided by track lights on the ceiling.
